title: MemPalace/mempalace
claim: MemPalace/mempalace — The best-benchmarked open-source AI memory system. And it's free.
why_good: Positions as the best-benchmarked open-source memory layer for agents — memory is a real, unsolved need every agent product hits.
value: People with years of assistant history who change models often — a paid local app, plus a team tier for firms whose transcripts cannot leave the building.
risk: If Anthropic or OpenAI ship durable cross-session memory by default, the whole category collapses into a one-off migration tool.

zh.claim: MemPalace/mempalace —— 跑分最好的开源 AI 记忆系统,而且免费。
zh.why_good: 定位为 agent 的跑分最好开源记忆层——记忆是每个 agent 产品都会撞上、且尚未解决的真实需求。
zh.value: 拥有多年助手历史、又经常换模型的人——付费本地应用，加上一个面向「记录不能出楼」的公司团队版。
zh.risk: Anthropic / OpenAI 一旦默认提供跨会话持久记忆，整个品类就塌缩成一次性迁移工具。
zh.hook: 那些把工作生活都接到助手上、又被 30 天过期一次清空的开发者——有人宁可让 miner 以 100% CPU 跑上 38 小时，也不肯放弃那份档案。
zh.does: 本地优先的 AI 助手记忆层：对话原文逐字保存（不摘要、不改写），用语义检索在结构化索引上取回——人和项目是 wing，话题是 room，原文放在 drawer——检索后端可插拔（默认 ChromaDB）。宣称在 LongMemEval 上 R@5 达 96.6%，且零 API 调用。
zh.gap: 只有极客用得了：uv/pipx 安装、命令行、还要手工接 Claude Code hooks——而普通人真正想要的那句话（「我的助手记得我，而且记忆留在我自己机器上」）外面根本没有产品。
zh.counter: 记忆是 agent 基建里争夺最凶的一层：Mem0、Zep、Letta 都拿了钱在发版，而 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 正把持久记忆变成平台原语——一旦如此，所有第三方记忆库都从产品退化成迁移工具。README 要专门警告仿冒站点分发恶意软件，也说明这个名字本身几乎没有护城河。
zh.differentiator: 不做又一个记忆库，做消费级「可携带记忆」应用：一次性导入 ChatGPT、Claude、Copilot 的历史，全部留在本地，然后把相关的一小段交给用户今天正在用的那个助手。锁定来自用户自己的档案，而不是厂商。
zh.consumer_angle: 普通人正在因为过期和换模型丢掉好几年的助手历史；产品是跟着人走的本地档案，不是 SDK。

hook: Developers who have wired their working life into an assistant and lost it to a 30-day expiry — one ran the miner for 38 hours at 100% CPU rather than give the archive up.
pick_reason: The project appears to be a collection of existing concepts without a clear, unique value proposition or business model.

voices.quote: I love the tool, but I'm seeing this pretty much every time I complete a task for my work: sessions lose the ability to write
A background `mempalace mine --mode projects` run spun for 38 hours at 100% of one core
Mine dedup is keyed by `source_file + mtime` globally, not per-wing. Once a transcript is mined into any wing, it cannot be re-mined into a different one

does: Local-first memory for AI assistants: conversations are stored verbatim (never summarised or paraphrased) and retrieved by semantic search over a structured index — wings for people and projects, rooms for topics, drawers for the raw text — on a pluggable vector backend (ChromaDB by default). Claims 96.6% R@5 on LongMemEval with zero API calls.
gap: Only geeks can use it: uv/pipx install, a CLI, and hand-wired Claude Code hooks — while the thing ordinary people actually want ('my assistant remembers me, and the memory stays on my machine') has no product wrapped around it.
counter: Memory is the most contested layer in agent infra: Mem0, Zep and Letta are funded and shipping, and OpenAI and Anthropic are turning durable memory into a platform primitive — the moment they do, every third-party store becomes a migration chore rather than a product. That the README has to warn users about impostor domains distributing malware tells you how little moat the name itself carries.
differentiator: Not another store — a consumer portable-memory app: import ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot history once, keep it local, and hand the relevant slice to whichever assistant the user is in today. The lock-in is the user's own archive, not a vendor's.
consumer_angle: Ordinary people are already losing years of assistant history to expiry and model-switching; the product is a local archive that follows them between assistants, not an SDK.
